summary: TRUE END-TO-END: Salesforce scratch org Apex Http.send -> Azure Function (Event Grid webhook) -> Dataverse (HTTP 201 Created). The full pipeline fired from Salesforce and persisted a real record in Dataverse, captured in Application Insights.

previousDiagnosisCorrected.claim: scratch orgs proxy outbound HTTP and 500 on *.azurewebsites.net
previousDiagnosisCorrected.actual: scratch orgs CAN reach *.azurewebsites.net. The previous 'proxy 500' error was a misread of a cold-start timeout. The function was unresponsive because the deployed package.json had an invalid glob ('src/functions/*.js') preventing runtime registration, so the host returned 500. After fixing package.json + redeploying, callouts succeed in ~1s when warm.
